hero.title: From accident photo to settlement in
hero.subtitle: AutoClaim AI verifies your documents, checks photo authenticity, assesses vehicle damage and estimates repair cost — then routes the claim to a human adjuster with a full, explainable AI report.
hero.note: No paperwork. No branch visits. Full transparency at every step.

pipeline.title: Eight AI stages, one claim
pipeline.subtitle: Every claim passes through the same verifiable pipeline. Each stage produces a score that is shown to the adjuster — nothing is a black box.
pipeline.step1Desc: Accident photos, RC book, driving licence, policy copy, FIR and claim form are uploaded from your phone.
pipeline.step2Desc: Policy number, vehicle number, owner name, expiry and claim details are extracted and cross-verified with the policy record.
pipeline.step3Desc: A vision transformer checks whether the accident photographs are real camera captures, edited or AI-generated.
pipeline.step4Desc: A CNN identifies brand, model and year from the photos and confirms it matches the insured vehicle.
pipeline.step5Desc: YOLOv11 locates every dent, scratch, broken lamp and panel with per-damage confidence scores.
pipeline.step6Desc: Damage area and depth are scored as minor, moderate, major or total loss.
pipeline.step7Desc: An ML model estimates parts, labour, painting and other charges using the vehicle's IDV and market rates.
pipeline.step8Desc: Fraud and coverage agents produce a structured decision record: auto-approve, manual review or fraud suspected.
pipeline.note: Every stage is logged. Adjusters can re-run the pipeline or override any single stage manually.

features.title: Built for real claim desks
features.subtitle: A complete insurance workflow — not a demo form. Customers, adjusters and administrators each get a purpose-built workspace.
features.f1Desc: Late intimation, inflated estimates, repeated claims, tampered images and document mismatches are scored into a single risk number with every contributing signal listed.
features.f2Desc: The coverage agent retrieves the actual clauses from the policy and states whether the reported damage is covered — citing the clause number.
features.f3Desc: Each claim carries a decision record with the signals, weights, model versions and confidence behind the recommendation.
features.f4Desc: Adjusters can re-run the AI, edit the assessment, request more documents, approve a reduced amount or reject with remarks.
features.f5Desc: Approved claims move to a Razorpay-ready settlement step with receipts, references and a complete payment history.
features.f6Desc: Track straight-through-processing rate, average verification time, fraud flags and weekly claim volume in one view.

how.title: How a claim moves
how.subtitle: Four steps from the roadside to your bank account.
how.s1Desc: Capture photos at the spot, add the incident details and upload your documents. The form takes about two minutes.
how.s2Desc: Documents are read, photos are checked for manipulation, damage is detected and the repair cost is estimated.
how.s3Desc: A human reviews the AI report, can request more evidence, and approves or rejects with written remarks.
how.s4Desc: Approved amount is paid to your account and the receipt stays available in your claim timeline.

security.title: Trust is the product
security.subtitle: Insurance runs on evidence. AutoClaim AI keeps every decision auditable.
security.p1: Every AI stage writes a timestamped result that cannot be edited after review
security.p2: Document fields are cross-verified against the policy record, not trusted blindly
security.p3: Image forensics flags AI-generated, edited or heavily compressed photographs
security.p4: Full audit trail of every admin action, decision and payout reference

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: The things customers ask before their first claim.
faq.q1: Do I need to visit a branch?
faq.a1: No. The entire claim — photographs, documents, verification and settlement — is handled online. Only a physical survey may be requested for total-loss cases.
faq.a2: The AI pipeline completes in seconds. A human adjuster reviews the report, usually within one working day.
faq.a3: RC book, valid driving licence, your policy copy, the claim form and accident photographs. An FIR is required for theft, third-party injury and hit-and-run cases.
faq.q4: Can I upload photos taken later?
faq.a4: Yes, but photographs taken at the accident spot are far easier to verify. Images with missing or inconsistent metadata are flagged for manual review.
faq.q5: What if my policy has expired?
faq.a5: Claims are only payable if a policy was in force on the incident date. The coverage agent checks this automatically and explains the decision with the relevant clause.
faq.a6: A human adjuster always confirms the outcome. The AI produces a recommendation with evidence; it never pays a claim on its own.
